description: Given a short description of a business, returns the closest GramForge use case, what the assistant would do for it, a suggested plan and a sign-up link with the description prefilled so the owner only enters an email.

description.description: The business in the owner's words: what they offer, prices, hours, what clients should be able to do (20–2000 characters).

language.description: Language of the returned page links (ISO 639-1). Default en.

name: match_business
title: Match a business to a use case
